definition.summary: Fused query/key/value projection width of a gated-delta layer, `2*key_heads*head_dim + value_heads*head_dim`.
definition.description: A sum, not a product of declared axes: the axis carries no factors and the shape alone does not say how to partition it by head (O5.10). The contract's description fixes the order of the channels: query, key, then value.
definition.note: fused QKV width of the delta rule; a sum, hence no factors
